summary: TCW Specialty Lending LLC filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) to provide an unaudited schedule of transferred investments in connection with a previously reported transaction (Original 8-K filed April 7, 2026). The schedule lists various loan investments (e.g., first lien term loans, revolvers) transferred to the registrant as of April 1, 2026, but does not disclose the counterparty, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. The filing is a corrective disclosure of financial schedules, not a special situation event. No deal terms are stated. There is no actionable risk-arb angle as the transaction context is already reported.
